name: SimWorks Froggy seatpost - black / 300mm
description:
This SimWorks/Nitto seatpost was named "Froggy" because of its frog-like appearance when viewed from the side. 🐸
Featuring a highly polished  anodized finish and attractive silkscreened graphics, it has 24mm setback and is available in 300 and 350mm lengths.
The Froggy seatpost utilizes a strong two-bolt clamping system - the same as Nitto's NJS seatposts - which is a rock-solid design going back decades. This clamping style has the ability to grab the saddle rails very securely and stays in place on even the most intense rides. Additionally, minor adjustments to saddle angle can be easily performed.

It's a one-bolt design so setup is quick and as long as you grease the bolt, use a long 6mm allen and put some muscle to it, it'll grip forever and will never slip.
